purpose: Teach: 乗り出し/幾何/高揚/恣意/乖離/排他/占拠/屈辱

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新事業に乗り出した経緯を社員に伝えろ
lines.en: Make sure the staff understands why we've moved into this new business.
lines.style: Direct, measured authority. Clipped cadence. Each phrase lands with purpose. No inflection—purely instructional. The tone of someone used to being obeyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員に幾何学的思考を奨励します
lines.en: Understood. I'll encourage the team to think systematically about this shift.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive acknowledgment. Slight lean-forward in the voice—eager to confirm understanding. Calm, professional delivery. The assurance of someone taking careful notes.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、成功時の高揚を冷静さで包め
lines.en: When we succeed, temper the celebration with clear heads. Don't lose sight.
lines.style: Firm, almost protective in tone. Pause before the core instruction. Quiet weight on 'clear heads'—this is the point. No room for misinterpretation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。恣意的な評価を排除する制度を整備します
lines.en: Understood. I'll establish processes that prevent bias from clouding our judgment.
lines.style: Steady, confident confirmation. Slight quickening—showing he's already thinking through implementation. Professional but engaged, not robotic. A nod in his voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、お客様要求との乖離を防げ
lines.en: Don't let us drift apart from what our customers actually need.
lines.style: Sharp focus, almost urgent underneath the calm. Direct eye-contact in the voice. The weight of a warning dressed as instruction. Spare, exact phrasing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内文化が排他的にならぬよう注意します
lines.en: Understood. I'll make sure our internal culture stays open and responsive to that.
lines.style: Prompt, thoughtful reply. Slightly slower pace—showing deliberation. Warm undertone beneath the formality. The sound of someone genuinely committing to the task.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、競合に市場を占拠されぬよう動け
lines.en: Move fast. Don't let competitors seize market share while we're slow.
lines.style: Clipped, energetic. A touch of urgency beneath the control. Final phrase sharpened—this is what matters. The voice of someone who knows what's at stake.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の屈辱を生まない職場作りを徹底します
lines.en: Understood. I'll build a workplace where people aren't made to feel diminished.
lines.style: Firm, almost protective. Slight deepening of tone on the final clause—this matters personally, not just operationally. Measured but with quiet conviction underneath.
